verification.precondition: One durable run has one current SurveyFrame assignment and two callers hold the same completed form.
verification.stimulus: Submit both forms concurrently through independent surveyctl command executions, then authenticate and validate persisted state.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Exactly one submission commits, one loses or is rejected, revision advances once, and the resulting replay remains valid.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: two concurrent surveyctl submissions produce one commit and never corrupt the session
verification.forbiddenMutation: Concurrent callers must not both commit, overwrite each other, fork the journal, or leave an invalid session.

behavior: two concurrent surveyctl submissions produce one commit and never corrupt the session
